id: # The priority table of the AI planner (knowledge/ai.md: a small set of options each turn). One row for each kind of proposal.
# The planner proposes a command of the row when its condition holds; a higher priority goes first; urgency adds up to 20. All numbers are assumed (Q-185).
# patrol: below 90, above order.bandit_threshold (80). Bandits start below 80 and end at 80. A patrol below 70 left them in the city, and they destroyed its facilities (the play run of 2026-11-07).
# reward: 52, above develop. At 30 the gold went to the facilities, and the officers left (U-011).
# produce: 56, above conscript, while the weapons are fewer than the soldiers. sortie: 45. A soldier without a weapon cannot march (U-012).
# alliance: 同盟 with the friendliest neighbour at war, when another enemy stands near. break: 摒棄 with an allied neighbour when no enemy stands near (U-015).
